function.name: mark_disposition
function.description: Records the final call disposition status, category, and descriptive call notes in the CRM database.

customer_id.description: Unique database ID of the customer (e.g. cust_rahul_001).

disposition_code.description: The final call disposition code. Must be one of: 'PTP' (Promise to Pay), 'ALREADY_PAID', 'DISPUTED', 'WRONG_NUMBER', 'DNC' (Do Not Call), 'THIRD_PARTY', 'UNVERIFIED' (Failed security verification), 'HOSTILE', 'CALL_BACK'.

call_notes.description: Descriptive summary details of the call (e.g. 'Rahul Sharma promised to pay ₹8499 by tomorrow using UPI. Sent link.').
